properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1404449
Incident Time: 2024-07-11 21:30:00
Nearest City: London, Ontario, CN
Location: 3700 OLD VICTORIA ROAD
Location2: LONDON DAIRY FARM
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: MANURE- PARTICULATES AND MANURE FROM COW PENS
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: LONDON DAIRY FARM
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 42.937532, -81.13206 (Approximated from premise)
Report Description///NEEC INCIDENT NOTIFICATION: BARN FIRE WITH DOUSE WATER AND MANURE RUNOFF./// BARN IS BLAZING CURRENTLY AND THERE ARE A NUMBER OF TRUCKS APPLYING WATER. FD COMMANDER ADVISED RUNOFF WOULD BE PARTICULATES AND MANURE FROM THE COW PENS, NOT MANURE STORAGE. IT IS DRAINING TO THE SOUTH AND THERE IS A CATCHBASIN ON THE PROPERTY WHERE EVERYTHING IS DRAINING INTO. CALLER DOES NOT KNOW THE INFRASTRUCTURE. THERE IS A POND TO THE SE OF THE PROPERTY SO HE THINKS IT MIGHT GO TO THE PRIVATE POND ON THE PROPERTY. NOT AWARE OF ANY EVACUATIONS OR SHELTER IN PLACE. SMOKE IS GOING STRAIGHT UP, GREY. THIS IS NOT THE FIRST TIME THERE HAS BEEN A FIRE AT THE PROPERTY. THEY HAVE JUST USED WATER NOT ANY FOAM. CALLER IS NOT AWARE OF ANY SENSITIVE RECEPTORS OR WATERCOURSES NEARBY. THERE ARE SOME MUNICIPAL DRAINS IN THE VICINITY BUT HE IS NOT FAMILIAR WITH WHERE THE CATCHBASIN ON THE PROPERTY IS LEADING. HIS BOSS WAS ASKING SINCE IT IS DIFFICULT TO SEE THE SITE IF IT WOULD BE BEST TO MEET MECP ON SITE FIRST THING IN THE MORNING. I ASKED IF THERE IS ANY WAY TO REDUCE OFFSITE RUNOFF AND HE SAID NOT REALLY DUE TO THE WATER FLOW. THE CITY ADVISED THERE IS NOT MUCH THEY CAN DO AT THIS TIME. I REQUESTED THAT HE REACH OUT TO THE FD TO GET THE SITE CONTACT TO ASK WHERE THE DRAIN GOES. IF THEY CAN FIND OUTFALLS THERE COULD BE POTENTIAL TO PUT IN SOME HAYBALES OR OTHER FILTERS TO REDUCE IMPACTS.

***WEB REPORT*** THE M/V ANGELIA B, VN:631713, REPORTED A HYDRAULIC OIL LEAK IN THE RUDDER COMPARTMENT AT APPROX. 0715, 03DEC13, WHILE MOORED AT THE EVANSVILLE MARINE SERVICE (EMS) FACILITY. THE TANKERMAN ON DUTY REPORTED IT TO ME, THE SAFETY COORDINATOR FOR EMS. AT IT'S LARGEST, THE SHEEN WAS APPROX. 15' X 2', AND WAS SILVERY/GRAY IN COLOR. BEST ESTIMATES ARE THAT LESS THAN 1 PINT WAS RELEASED INTO THE RIVER. ATTEMPTS WERE MADE TO CONTAIN THE SPILL, WHICH REMAINED TRAPPED BEHIND THE VESSEL FOR SEVERAL MINUTES, BUT THE SHEEN WAS NOT ABSORBED BY THE OIL PADS. THE MECHANIC ON DUTY BOARDED THE VESSEL AND FOUND THE CAUSE. THE LEAK IS NOW CONTAINED, BUT HAS NOT BEEN REPAIRED AT THIS TIME. EXPECTED REPAIRS SHOULD BE COMPLETE WITHIN THE HOUR.

properties.summary: Incident Type: VESSEL - NRC Report ID: 995183 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party:
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 995183
Incident Time: 2011-11-10 15:00:00
Nearest City: Nome, AK
Incident Type: VESSEL
Material: OIL: DIESEL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party:
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 64.495347, -165.407076 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Reported Spill Volume: 5 gallons
Report Description
NOME HARBOR EXPERIENCED VERY HIGH WATER (+10 MLLW) AROUND 1700 ON 9 NOV 2011. TUG RUSTLER WAS MOORED IN SOUTHEAST CORNER OF HARBOR STERN TO A GRAVEL BANK. AS WATER ROSE THE VESSEL WAS PULLED BACK TOWARD THE BANK TO GROUND FOR WINTER ICE PERIOD. THE VESSEL WAS APPARENTLY LEFT UNATTENDED AS THE WATERS RECEDED AND AS IT GROUNDED IT WAS TOO FAR OFF THE SHEET PILE WALL TO REMAIN REASONABLY UPRIGHT (WITH ONLY A SLIGHT LIST TO PORT) AND LEANED WELL BEYOND A 45 DEGREE ANGLE. THE PORT BOW AND MID-SHIP GUNNELS ARE UNDERWATER AND SOME OIL PRODUCT HAS BEEN RELEASED FROM EQUIPMENT AND TOOLS THAT WERE ON THE DECK. OWNER HAS BEEN NOTIFIED TO RESPOND. SMALL CHUNKS OF ICE SURROUND THE VESSEL AND THE WATER IS CALM THEREFORE DO NOT EXPECT A LOT OF SPREADING AT THIS POINT. THIS COULD CHANGE IF ANOTHER STORM SYSTEM APPROACHED THE REGION. WILL CONTINUE TO WORK WITH RESPONSIBLE PARTY.

DUE TO PRECIPITATION IN THE AREA, THE DIESEL FUEL WAS WASHED ACROSS THE ASPHALT LOT AND HAS IMPACTED THE ONSITE RETENTION POND. NY DEC AND FIRE DEPARTMENT PERSONNEL ARE REPORTEDLY ONSITE AND AN ENVIRONMENTAL CONTRACTOR IS CURRENTLY ON ROUTE.
